message.content: Hola. I need to send a quick message to the new guitar teacher. I think I have the wrong contact saved. Can you draft a text asking him to confirm our Tuesday session at 7 PM? Also, I need to pay the monthly fee for the flamenco group we sing with. The card ending in 42 is acting up, so let's use my Visa Classic.

content.text:
I can help with both. For the payment, I see your Visa Classic is available. Shall I proceed with the 45€ transfer to the flamenco group's account now?

For the message, here is a draft for Javier: "Hola Javier, it's Inés. Just confirming our guitar lesson this Tuesday at 7 PM as usual. Let me know if that still works for you. See you then."

message.content: Yes, please go ahead with the payment. And yes, the message looks good. Just send it to Javier el de la Cruz. I want to make sure he knows I'm not confusing him with Rafael de Utrera, who taught me before. It's a bit awkward switching instructors so suddenly.

content.text:
Payment of 45€ processed successfully via your Visa Classic.

I've updated your contact list. The message to Javier el de la Cruz has been sent. I've also noted that he has replaced Rafael de Utrera as your instructor so I don't mix them up in the future. Is there anything else you need for your Sunday planning?
